results.title: Ledyard National Bank Purchases 10,214 Shares of Vanguard Information Technology ETF $VGT
results.description: Ledyard National Bank raised its position in Vanguard Information Technology ETF (NYSEARCA:VGT – Free Report) by 660.7% during the second quarter, according to its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). results.title: Census 2027: PM Modi urges youth to help families accurate information during online self-enumeration
results.description: Census 2027: PM Modi urged youth to help families provide accurate information digitally during self-enumeration, saying reliable data will shape policies, welfare schemes and India's development plans. He asked households to check forms carefully.
